title: Company Directory
subtitle: Manage corporate entities and their departmental structures
deleteText: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? This action cannot be undone.
accessRestrictedDesc: Your account does not have the necessary clearance to view the company directory.
companyInformationDesc: Initialize a new corporate Company within the ecosystem
companyDescPlaceholder: Describe the company mission and operations...
geolocationPlaceholder: Google Maps link or landmark notes
noOverview: No strategic overview provided for this business unit.
eliminateDeptDesc: This will dissolve the department structure. Personnel will remain but unassigned.
companyCommSettingsDesc: Configure sender aliases, default mailbox routing, and domain identity in one panel.
pickCompanyProfile: Pick the company profile whose mail infrastructure you want to manage.
domainDesc: Set the official domain used to verify outbound communication origin.
authorizedSendersDesc: Add sender aliases and click any row to mark it as the default address.
invalidFormatDesc: Please enter a valid credential email
defaultSenderUsed: Default sender used by system messages
clickToMarkDefault: Click to mark as default sender
deliveryPolicyDesc: Addresses registered here will be available as "From" aliases in the automated messaging system. The "Default Protocol" address is used for all system-triggered transactional correspondence and recovery protocols.
restrictedProtocolDesc: Your account does not have authorization to manage communication infrastructure.
gmailSubtitle: Send emails to applicants from your own Gmail account for free, and receive their replies here.
gmailStep1Desc: Google only allows App Passwords on accounts with 2-Step Verification.
gmailStep2Desc: Name it anything (e.g. "Hiring system"). Google shows a 16-letter password once — copy it.
gmailStep3Desc: Enter your Gmail address and the 16-letter App Password — not your normal Gmail password.
gmailAppPasswordPlaceholder: App Password (e.g. abcd efgh ijkl mnop)
gmailReceiveCheckbox: Also bring applicant replies into the system
gmailSecurityNote: Your App Password is encrypted and never shown again. You can revoke it anytime from your Google account, which disconnects it here too.
gmailConnectedDesc: Emails will now be sent from {email}.
gmailConnectedSendOnly: Sending works, but replies can't be received yet:
gmailReceiveDesc: Replies from applicants are checked every 5 minutes and shown on their profile. Other emails in your inbox are ignored.
gmailReceiveNotInPlan: Receiving replies isn't included in your current plan.
gmailSyncDoneDesc: {stored} new applicant replies imported ({scanned} new emails checked).
gmailDisconnectConfirmDesc: Emails will stop being sent from this Gmail account and replies will no longer be imported. Past emails stay in the system.
replySubdomainDesc: Applicant replies to emails sent from your custom domain come back here. In your DNS, add one MX record for this subdomain pointing to Resend Inbound, and subscribe your Resend webhook to the email.received event.
replySubdomainWarning: Use a subdomain only (e.g. reply.yourcompany.com). Never add Resend's MX record to your main domain — that would send all of your company's email here instead of your normal mailbox.
gmailGoogleDesc: The quickest way: approve access on Google's page and you're connected. No App Password needed.
gmailOrAppPassword: Or connect with an App Password
gmailGoogleConnectedDesc: Your Gmail is connected. Emails to applicants will now be sent from it.
